title: useImperativeHandle: expose only what you choose

slides.text: Expose a handle, not the node 🎛️
slides.say: Passing a ref to an input gives the parent the whole DOM node. It can change styles, anything. Sometimes you want to limit that.
Use imperative handle tells React to give the parent your own object instead. Here the parent only gets a focus method.
So the parent’s ref dot current is the handle object, not the input element.

slides.text: Don’t overuse it. If it can be a prop, like isOpen, make it a prop.
slides.say: Do not overuse refs. If you can express it as a prop, like is open on a modal, use a prop instead of open and close methods.
